messages.subject: Re: Coverage probability
parts:
It's not a problem to have a covered area larger than the survey area (exce=
pt possibly for finite popn correction issues), but I would certainly trunc=
ate the one large distance regardless. See the discussion on choice of trun=
cation distance w in the introductory distance sampling book.
